summary: Big tech is carrying the tape: the S&P 500 and Nasdaq are higher while the Dow slips as the 10-year yield climbs back over 5.3%. AI names are catching bids on fresh analyst optimism and strong supplier data.
market_note: Monday open: S&P and Nasdaq futures pointed up, Dow roughly flat; bond yields and oil in focus this week.

items.why: Extending last week's AI-driven rally after reports of a new in-house AI chip and expanding compute capacity; Friday's pop pushed the stock above its 200-day moving average for the first time in months.
Riding Friday's pop after Q3 deliveries of 486,532 beat Wall Street estimates of roughly 450,000 to 460,000, with analysts citing strength despite the expired federal EV tax credit.

Melius Research upgraded the stock to Buy with a $665 target, calling Microsoft the trusted 'adult in charge' of enterprise AI as safety fears steer customers toward its governance and security tools.
Chasing a record high after AI server partner Foxconn reported September-quarter revenue up 47% year over year, signaling AI hardware demand keeps booming.
